blocks.text: Ezekiel 46 contains 24 verses. It opens with: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened. It concludes with: Then said he unto me, These are the boiling-houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.
